newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- One of two British nurses charged with murdering an Australian nurse was arrested while withdrawing money using victim's bank card.
- Kuwaiti businessmen to set up company in Egypt with a capital of $500 million.
- United Arab Emirates' minister of state expects 15-20 percent growth in bank profits this year.
- Linkage of Kuwaiti, Egyptian and Lebanese bourses to start on January six.
- Britain ready to help Arab privatisation programmes, British minister says.
- Emirates Industrial Bank granted loans worth 330 million dirhams in 1996.
